note: c12: 大浦 (Ōura), the east shore of the inner bay: the shipyard, the village around 大浦簡易郵便局, 厳島神社 and the rebuilt 大浦 fishing port; the west 60 % is open water. Read from Google Earth 3D (imagery 2026-03-11) in raw/ref/earth/c12 (full = the whole cell, N/M/S = 250 x 210 m shore sub-cells with top + o0/o90/o180; e_*.jpg / z_*.jpg = Earth | GSI | app ortho-rectified on the ENU grid; sheets_before = per-lot sheets), checked against the GSI photo and OSM. Generated by raw/ref/earth/c12/make_c12.py.
